OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

<groupId>org.openapitools</groupId>
                <artifactId>openapi-generator-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <!-- RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <version>${maven.openapi-generator-plugin.version}</version>
                <!-- /RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>generate</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <inputSpec>${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/openapi.yml</inputSpec>
                            <generatorName>spring</generatorName>
                            <library>spring-boot</library>

                            <!-- Only enabling model andopenapi-generator-maven-plugin API generation -->
                            <modelNameSuffix>Dto</modelNameSuffix>
                            <apiPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.api</apiPackage>
                            <generateModels>true</generateModels>
                            <modelPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto</modelPackage>
                            <generateApis>true</generateApis>
                            <importMappings>
                                <importMapping>Nullable=org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable</importMapping>
                            </importMappings>
                            <configOptions>
                                <!-- RestController implementation is provided by Petclinic developers -->
                                <interfaceOnly>true</interfaceOnly>
                                <!-- Generate API interfaces from OpenAPI tags -->
                                <useTags>true</useTags>
                                <!-- Activating Java 8 features -->
                                <performBeanValidation>true</performBeanValidation>

## Summary

I implemented create-time telephone normalization for `POST /api/owners`, following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions.

**New pipeline step** (`owners.POST.yml`): inserted a `normalize` step between `validate` and `build`, so it runs after `ValidateOwnerFields` guarantees a non-blank telephone but before the DTO is mapped to an entity.

**Files added:**
- `NormalizeOwnerTelephone.java` — a single-responsibility step that strips every non-digit (`replaceAll("\\D", "")`), requires exactly 10 digits, and mutates the published `OwnerFieldsDto` in place so the stored/returned value is the normalized 10-digit string. Throws `InvalidTelephoneException` otherwise.
- `InvalidTelephoneException.java` — a checked exception for the reject case.
- `InvalidTelephoneExceptionHandler.java` + its escalation YAML — responds 400, reusing the existing `FieldErrorsResponse` record (`{"errors":["telephone"]}`) rather than introducing a new response shape.

**Why this shape:** normalization lives in its own step instead of being bolted onto `ValidateOwnerFields` (which owns required-field checks), keeping each class to one responsibility. The 400 path reuses the existing error-body record and the established escalation-handler pattern.

Both tests pass: `"(04) 1234-5678"` normalizes and is stored/returned as `0412345678`; `"12345"` is rejected with 400.
